title: loop_stall_guard revived/resolver_revived latches set once and never reset on recovery
refutes_if: revived or resolver_revived is reset to False when snapshot/resolver age returns fresh

evidence.quote:
if consecutive_stale == 1 and not revived:
            revived = True

note: consecutive_stale resets on fresh snapshot but revived/resolver_revived never reset — second stale episode skips revive attempts
